data.one_liner: Manages versions and compatibility for awesome_notifications plugins.
data.what_it_does: Provides a core helper plugin that coordinates versions across the awesome_notifications ecosystem, ensuring compatibility between local notifications and FCM plugins.
use_when: You are using multiple plugins from the awesome_notifications ecosystem in your project.
You want to ensure automated version alignment and compatibility between awesome_notifications packages.
avoid_when: You are not using the awesome_notifications plugin ecosystem.
You prefer to manually manage all dependency versions in your pubspec.yaml.
strengths: Simplifies version management for the awesome_notifications family of plugins.
Ensures compatibility across local and remote notification modules.
weaknesses: Tied exclusively to the awesome_notifications suite.
Requires using specific setup instructions for managing plugin dependencies.
data.setup_notes: Add the core package and related awesome_notifications plugins to pubspec.yaml following the documented version guidelines.

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a standalone local notifications plugin that does not rely on the awesome_notifications core management system.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a fully managed push notification backend service rather than a local-first custom notification setup.
